verdict.rationale: Marketing copy for the LegalZoom virtual mail offering, which Earth Class Mail is now part of, makes two of the three claims. It says mail is opened and scanned in company-operated facilities with access controls, and that mail is protected by 256-bit AES encryption and two-factor authentication. These are single-line claims, not detailed security documentation, and staff screening is not addressed at all. Missing for 10: any evidence of staff screening or background checks, in-depth documentation of facility controls and encryption scope (at rest vs. in transit for scans), and independent corroboration or certifications.
